sentences: Traders moved $541 million through Polymarket in the week of 2026-09-14, across 16.0 million individual trades. Algorithmic wallets accounted for 63% of weekly counterparty events (both maker and taker sides counted); everyone else split the remaining 37%.
The most-traded market was "Will United Russia (ER) gain the most seats in the next Russian parliamentary election?", pulling in $7 million of volume. Politics dominated the week's attention.
Both sides made money this week. Bots collected $8K (+100 bps); retail collected $76 (+25 bps).
